description: Explicit exchange binding declaration for DSHC pipeline symbols. LC.SHF is permanently INVALID; LC.GFE is the sole valid exchange binding for lithium carbonate (product=LC, exchange=GFE).
scope: DSHC pipeline (F01 fetch, aligned tables, factor extraction)

LC.invalid_reason: GFE exchange only — LC.SHF does not exist on Wind; all indicators return 0 rows (confirmed DSHC-F01, DSHC-T1, DSHC-VOL-PROBE, DSHC-VOL-FULL)
evidence: DSHC-F01: LC.SHF all 4 indicators COMBO-FAIL (rows=0, all 3 attempts)

auto_clear_contract.mechanism: P81 exchange binding audit scans dshc_* files. LC.SHF in files triggers EXCH-001-ATTRIBUTED-MISMATCH. Auto-clear triggers when LC.SHF absent from mismatches AND LC.GFE resolves BOUND_OK.
auto_clear_contract.repair_condition: Remove LC.SHF references from active dshc_* artifact files OR rely on P81 auto-clear when mismatch_count→0
auto_clear_contract.note: Historical dshc_* event/receipt files retain LC.SHF references as legitimate failure logs. These are audit trail, not active config. New dshc_* files MUST NOT reference LC.SHF.
